headline: Bezeq and Adgar Partner to Build Data Center in Petah Tikva
summary: Bezeq and Adgar are partnering to construct a data center in Petah Tikva as part of Bezeq's strategy to expand into AI infrastructure and new digital growth engines.
why: Bezeq is a major Israeli telecommunications provider diversifying into high-demand data center and cloud computing infrastructure.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Data center investments expand digital infrastructure capacity to meet surging enterprise and AI computing demand.
